steps.code:
# Let's parse the old songs list into structured data.
import re

content = _mem['s11']['content']
lines = content.strip().split('\n')
# Skip the header line "# List of Songs to Archive"
songs_to_archive = []
for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith('#'):
        continue
    # Format: "- Title by Artist1, Artist2, ..."
    # Remove leading "- "
    if line.startswith('- '):
        line = line[2:]
    # Split on " by " (case sensitive)
    if ' by ' in line:
        title_part, artists_part = line.split(' by ', 1)
        title = title_part.strip()
        artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(',')]
        songs_to_archive.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists})
    else:
        # If no " by ", treat whole as title
        songs_to_archive.append({'title': line.strip(), 'artists': []})

print(songs_to_archive)
